messages.author: 594ccf7cd500f8e9
messages.subject: Comparegeno in R/qtl
parts:
Hello Karl
I am trying to compare my genotypes and remove the ones with duplicate individuals. Below are my R commands however on the last command I get an error
Kindly advice where I have made a mistake. Thanks

comparegeno(WxA)
cg<-comparegeno(WxA)# identify duplicate individuals
hist(cg[lower.tri(cg)],breaks = seq(0,1,len=101),xlab = "No. matching genotypes")
rug(cg[lower.tri(cg)])
wh<-which(cg>0.95,arr=T)
wh<-wh[wh[,1]<wh[,2],]
wh
g<-pull.geno(WxA)
table(g[58],g[59])
 WxA<-subset(WxA,ind = -wh[,2]) 

Error in wh[, 2] : incorrect number of dimensions

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Comparegeno in R/qtl
parts:
It may be that you have just one pair of duplicates, in which case you'd need to change the 6th line to

wh <- wh[wh[,1]<wh[,2], , drop=FALSE]

This ensures that the 'wh' object remains a matrix so that the last line works properly.

karl
